_comment: The second new market stall's mini-buy surface. Rides krshia_crate.json's EXACT shop-option contract (requires:{gold:price} paired with effects:[{gold:-price},{item:id}], price named in the option's own text -- WIDialogue strips the generated 'Worth N gold' effect_line from a shop option by matching that literal prefix, so the price only ever appears once, authored here). Sells watch_issue_gambeson (20g -- previously fixture/harness-only, no live acquisition path) plus GH#70's training_bow (8g, index-2 append -- see that option's own comment for why it can't move earlier). The Peddler is a title, not a proper name (matches the existing gate_guard/watch_guard precedent for unnamed Watch-adjacent flavor NPCs) -- profile in docs/design/character-profiles-staging.md.

hub.speaker: Peddler
hub.text: Watch gear, mostly honest. Some of it's even been laundered.

options._comment: GH#70 [Archer]: the T1 bow's live purchase path. APPENDED at array end (index 2) so barracks_walkthrough.json's pinned 'confirm immediately -> index 0 gambeson' and its 'move down 1 -> index 1 in the bought node' both stay untouched -- inserting earlier would shift both.
options.text: That bow strung up back there. Practice grade. (8 gold)

bought.speaker: Peddler
bought.text: Deposit's already paid, so don't ask where it came from. Wear it in good health.
